question: Which Lavani singer got Padma Shri 2022 by the President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sulochana Chavan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sulochana Chavan** is a renowned Lavani singer from Maharashtra, India, known for her significant contribution to this traditional music genre.
 
• She was awarded the Padma Shri in 2022, one of India's highest civilian honors, recognizing her dedication to Indian arts and culture.
 
• Sulochana Chavan has been instrumental in popularizing the Lavani genre, which is a traditional folk music form of Maharashtra.
 
• Her work has earned her numerous accolades and widespread recognition, making her a celebrated figure in Indian music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Shri**

 
 
• The Padma Shri is the fourth highest civilian award in India, instituted in 1954.
 
• It is awarded to citizens of India in recognition of their distinguished contribution in various spheres such as arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• The award is conferred by the President of India at ceremonial functions held at Rashtrapati Bhavan.
 
• Recipients of the award are announced annually on Republic Day.
 
 
 
• **Lavani**
 
 
• Lavani is a genre of music popular in Maharashtra, India, known for its powerful rhythm and quick tempo.
 
• It is a combination of traditional song and dance, performed to the beats of Dholki, a percussion instrument.
 
• The word "Lavani" is derived from the word "Lavanya," which means beauty. It is traditionally performed by female performers wearing sarees, usually of nine yards.
 
• Lavani has played a significant role in the development of Marathi folk theatre.
